hints.title: Minute Conversion and Pigeonhole Principle
hints.text: A day contains 24 * 60 = 1440 minutes. If timePoints has more than 1440 elements, at least two times must be identical, yielding difference 0.

hints.title: Bucket Sort on Minute Timeline
hints.text: Convert each "HH:MM" into integer minutes from midnight. Mark presence in a boolean array of size 1440.

hints.title: Circular Wrap-Around Comparison
hints.text: Traverse the present minutes in ascending order, comparing adjacent times. Also compare the circular wrap-around gap: 1440 + first - last.

hints.title: See the blueprint

variables: N: number of time points (bounded by 1440)
complexity.notes: Optimal solution achieving O(N log N) time and O(N) auxiliary space.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: All-pairs difference check takes O(N^2) time, which is unnecessarily quadratic.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Sorting at most 1440 elements runs in under 1ms with minimal memory.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should check circular midnight wrap-around (1440 + first - last) and apply the pigeonhole early-exit.
